name: CSERP-001+002: 55 form components missing CSRF + 2 files with wrong getCsrfToken

steps_to_reproduce: 2. Navigate to any module (e.g., HR Payroll, Cargo Claims, Sales CRM)
3. Click 'Create New' or 'Edit' on any record
4. Fill in the form and submit
content.expected_behavior: Form submission succeeds. The fetch() call includes x-csrf-token header with the value from the cs_csrf cookie.
content.actual_behavior: 49 form components send NO x-csrf-token header. 6 form components send hardcoded '1'. 2 pages use a wrong local getCsrfToken() that reads 'csrf_token' cookie instead of 'cs_csrf'.
content.root_cause_analysis: CSRF protection (src/lib/csrf.ts + src/lib/client/csrf.ts) was added AFTER most modules were built. The form component template used during module generation did not include the CSRF import or header. 49 modules (MOD-001→MOD-055) have NO csrf at all. 6 later modules (MOD-057→060) got a hardcoded '1' placeholder. 2 E2E flow pages copy-pasted a wrong getCsrfToken() that reads the wrong cookie name.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: ALL 55 form components import getCsrfToken from @/lib/client/csrf
AC-2: ALL 55 form components include 'x-csrf-token': getCsrfToken() in fetch headers
AC-3: The 6 files with hardcoded '1' are updated to use getCsrfToken()
AC-4: The 2 files with wrong local getCsrfToken() delete their local function and import from @/lib/client/csrf
AC-5: No form component uses a hardcoded CSRF value ('1', 'csrf-placeholder', or empty string)
AC-6: All existing correct files (16 files listed in audit) remain unchanged
AC-7: After the fix, creating/editing a record in any module succeeds (no 403)
AC-8: The 7 files with uncommitted local fixes are included in the commit
edge_cases: Files with multiple fetch() calls (some forms have separate create vs update paths) — ALL fetch calls must get the header
The scm-form.tsx (Sales CRM) has a different structure (line 89-93) — verify it matches the pattern
step-input-form.tsx in processes/ already has getCsrfToken via a different import path — verify no duplication
admin-form.tsx and mels-form.tsx have slightly different header patterns (line 51-55) — verify compatibility
error_handling: If getCsrfToken() returns empty string (cookie not set), the API returns 403 CSRF_MISSING — this is correct behavior, login sets the cookie
The fix must NOT suppress CSRF errors — they should still appear if the cookie is genuinely missing
security_considerations: The CSRF token must come from the cs_csrf cookie, NOT be hardcoded
The token comparison on the server uses timingSafeEqual — no change needed server-side
All form components must use the centralized @/lib/client/csrf import, never a local function
affected_files: 6 files with hardcoded '1': lpr-form, fdp-form, mec-form, ecr-form, vrs-form, role-form
2 files with wrong getCsrfToken: e2e-flows/definition/[flowId]/page.tsx, processes/instances/[id]/page.tsx
7 files with uncommitted local fixes to be included
testing_requirements: Grep entire src/ for 'x-csrf-token.*"1"' — must return 0 results
Grep entire src/ for 'csrf-placeholder' — must return 0 results
Grep entire src/components for fetch POST/PATCH without getCsrfToken — must return 0 results (except auth pages)
Manual test: create a record in any module — should succeed
Manual test: edit a record in any module — should succeed
